name: Sakaar Outpost: MCU Space Colony
description: Build and manage a thriving space colony on the dystopian scrap world of Sakaar with MCU heroes, villains, Battleworld Incursion War Table, Doctor Doom's Cosmic Relic Forge, Multiverse Hero Vanguard, and the multi-turn Gemini AI Colony Guide Chatbot (F.R.I.D.A.Y., Miss Minutes, H.E.R.B.I.E., and Grandmaster).
